justification: Panel A depicts a winged eagle-headed anthropomorphic figure holding objects, flanked by a stylized tree with palmette-like foliage, all beneath a horizontal band of cuneiform inscription. Panel B depicts a radial, sunburst-like arrangement of lines converging on a central circular medallion containing a small crouching or seated figure, with no bird-headed figure, tree, or script band present; the compositional logic (radiating spokes to a center) is entirely different from the vertical figural/tree layout in A.
